milestones.label: Application deadline (Global South Trailblazer: the course's funding deadline in the University of Cambridge Course Directory)
milestones.source_text: The Cambridge Trust (official) says each course's funding deadline in the Course Directory applies. One scholarship site (scholarshipsforafricans.com, unofficial) reports 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027 for this award; these match the course funding dates Gates Cambridge (official) publishes.
